name: finbridge
description: Remote MCP server for Korean and US market data: DART and SEC EDGAR filings, corporate-action-adjusted Korean prices, screeners, insider activity, 13F holdings, and portfolio backtests.

interface.shortDescription: Korean + US market data for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: FinBridge is a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) that gives any MCP client unified access to Korean and US market data on one normalized schema: DART and SEC EDGAR filings, K-IFRS/US-GAAP financials, corporate-action-adjusted Korean daily prices and ETFs, insider trades, 13F holdings, technical indicators, valuation snapshots, named screeners over every Korean listing, and portfolio backtests. Serves only redistributable sources. Free tier: 100 metered calls a day, no card.
defaultPrompt: Run the Minervini trend template screen over Korean listings and show the top names.
Pull Samsung Electronics' latest DART financials and compare them with Apple's SEC filing.
Show recent insider trades and 13F holders for IREN.
